SELECT m.meal_id AS mealId, m.total_kcal AS totalKcal, d.difficulty, d.reason FROM meal_ai_detail d JOIN meal m ON d.meal_id = m.meal_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.meal_date = #{date} AND m.is_recommendation = true
